description: This Dart file defines the SecurePrefs class, a wrapper around SharedPreferences for secure storage of small key-value pairs, such as authentication tokens. It provides lazy initialization, methods for setting, getting, and removing tokens and strings, and encapsulates preferences management with a straightforward API.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: A lightweight static utility class providing methods to manage secure preferences such as auth tokens and generic strings, with lazy initialization and ease of use.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the SharedPreferences instance if it hasn't been initialized yet.

methods.name: _prefs
methods.description: Returns the SharedPreferences instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a string value under a specified key.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a specified key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a value associated with a specified key.
